description:
• Welcome to Fab + Flow Co, where we design and create unique personalized metal signs that make the perfect addition to any home or business. Our signs are made with quality materials and precision technology to enure they are both durable and visually appealing. As an affiliate, you'll have the opportunity to earn commission by promoting our products to your audience. Our products make excellent gifts for weddings, birthdays, housewarmings, and any other special occasion. When you become a Fab + Flow Co affiliate, you become part of our community and we will work with you to create a successful partnership. Join us in sharing the love for our personalized metal signs and earning commission along the way!

• Product description: We specialize in creating stunning personalized metal signs that add a touch of charm and personality to any space. Our collection includes a wide range of designs, from elegant monograms and family name signs to whimsical quotes and nature-inspired motifs. Our signs can be customized to suit individual preferences, allowing customers to personalize their pieces with names, dates or special messages. 
• USP (Unique Selling Point): We believe in providing exceptional customer service and ensuring that each customer is happy with their purchase. We take pride in our ability to transform ordinary spaces into extraordinary ones with our stunning collections of metal signs. 
• Payment terms: As an affiliate you will earn a 10% commission. on every qualifying sale referred by your unique affiliate link or coupon code. The rate excludes taxes and shipping fees. Commissions will be paid out on a monthly basis, within 10 days after the end of each calendar month. This allows us to accurately calculate and verify sales generated through your referrals. We offer convenient payment methods, including Paypal and Venmo. Please provide your preferred payment method and the necessary details for smooth and timely transactions. To ensure efficient processing, we have a minimum payout threshold of $30. Oncce your commissions reach this threshold, they will be eligible for payment in the next payout cycle. If the minimum threshold is not met, the commissions will be rolled over to the following month until the threshold is reached. Our referral codes last for 30 days, which means that if a customer makes a purchase within 30 days of clicking your affiliate link or using your coupon code, you will still receive the commissin for that sale. 
• Other information: We expect our affiliates to promote our brand and products responsibly and ethically. Any form of fraudulent or deceptive activity, such as spamming, false advertising, or hate is strictly prohibited. Violation of these terms may result in the termination of your affiliate partnership. 

By joining our affiliate program, you agree to comply with these payment terms and our overall affiliate program terms and conditions. We value our partnersip and look forward to building a mutually beneficial relationship with you.
